name: alex-loop
description: Design-to-implementation skill chain for Claude Code: feature-design, then feature-plan, then feature-implement, with an adversarial feature-challenge pass and a feature-panel multi-agent verifier. A feature-fix fast path handles scoped changes (bugs, chores, tweaks) with a known end-state, no design phase. Opt-in autonomous mode self-drives the chain after design approval, panel-gated to a unanimous bar. Bundles the feature-git-branch and feature-git-commit helpers plus session-injected workflow rules. A feature-config interview reviews and writes the repo-level directives (autonomous mode, commit policy, external models). A context-watchdog skill keeps working state across auto-compaction: a checkpoint is saved before it and restored after it. A worktree-add skill creates a sibling git worktree for parallel work, with per-worktree copies of the .env files and local notes and links for other ignored files; it needs Node 22+.
